rows.label: DECIMETER
rows.clue: A metric unit of length equal to one tenth of a meter

rows.label: FUDGE FACTOR
rows.clue: A quantity that is added or subtracted in order to increase the accuracy of a scientific measure

rows.label: LIMIT POINT
rows.clue: The mathematical value toward which a function goes as the independent variable approaches infinity

rows.label: SPOONFUL
rows.clue: As much as a spoon will hold

rows.label: POUND STERLING
rows.clue: The basic unit of money in Great Britain and Northern Ireland

rows.label: CUBIC FOOT
rows.clue: The volume equal to a cube one foot on each side

rows.label: HEAT UNIT
rows.clue: A unit of measurement for work

rows.label: SQUARE YARD
rows.clue: A unit of area equal to one yard by one yard square

rows.label: SPILLAGE
rows.clue: The amount that has spilled

rows.label: ACRE INCH
rows.clue: One twelfth of an acre-foot

rows.label: RIYAL
rows.clue: The basic unit of money in Saudi Arabia

rows.label: POWER UNIT
rows.clue: A measure of electric power

rows.label: PRIME NUMBER
rows.clue: An integer that has no integral factors but itself and 1

rows.label: WHISKER
rows.clue: A very small distance or space

rows.label: PAILFUL
rows.clue: The quantity contained in a pail

rows.label: GRAM ATOM
rows.clue: The quantity of an element whose weight in grams is numerically equal to the atomic weight of the element

rows.label: BREATHING ROOM
rows.clue: Sufficient room for easy breathing or movement

rows.label: OUNCE
rows.clue: A unit of apothecary weight equal to 480 grains or one twelfth of a pound

rows.label: WEIGHT UNIT
rows.clue: A decimal unit of weight based on the gram

rows.label: MODULUS
rows.clue: An integer that can be divided without remainder into the difference between two other integers

rows.label: SEVENTY
rows.clue: The cardinal number that is the product of ten and seven

rows.label: RATIONAL
rows.clue: An integer or a fraction

rows.label: PAIN UNIT
rows.clue: A unit measuring the intensity of pain

rows.label: AIR MILE
rows.clue: A unit of length used in navigation

rows.label: CURIE
rows.clue: A unit of radioactivity equal to the amount of a radioactive isotope that decays at the rate of 37,000,000,000 disintegrations per second

rows.label: MOUTHFUL
rows.clue: The quantity that can be held in the mouth

rows.label: GRAND
rows.clue: The cardinal number that is the product of 10 and 100

rows.label: NINETY
rows.clue: The cardinal number that is the product of ten and nine
